The Mission Bay coastline fixture was retrieved from the Overpass API on
2026-09-13. It contains OpenStreetMap data, © OpenStreetMap contributors,
under ODbL 1.0: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.

mission-bay-water-scene.json is the derived diorama geometry for center
37.77453, -122.389813 and radius 1000 metres. It retains source attribution
and can be regenerated using tools/convert-osm.mjs.

mission-bay-courtyard-relations.json and mission-bay-courtyard-scene.json
contain the building relations retrieved from the same area on 2026-09-13
and their derived scene. The same OpenStreetMap attribution and ODbL license
apply.
